_note: 2026-10-19: closes (pauses) a filled posting via POST /api/v1/item/lifecycle {item_id, action:'pause'}; pause hides it from seekers and is reversible. Verified on a test post.
name: close_job
description: Hide a job posting from seekers because the owner says it is filled or no longer needed. Call it ONLY for an existing posting with a real job_id, and only after the owner clearly said it is filled or not needed. Returns the new status; say it is removed only if the result shows lifecycle_status paused.

job_id.description: The existing posting's job_posting item_id (${job_id}); a real UUID, never 'Not Available'.
